points.name: Input Current Unbalance
points.vendorComment:
This UPS has 5 power modules.
302062 is for power module 1 input current unbalance state
302078 is for power module 2 input current unbalance state
302094 is for power module 3 input current unbalance state
302110 is for power module 4 input current unbalance state
302126 is for power module 5 input current unbalance state

The report bit value indicate status:
bit 0: Input Curr Unbalance Warning - R
bit 1: Input Curr Unbalance Warning - S
bit 2: Input Curr Unbalance Warning - T
bit 3: Input Curr Unbalance Warning - Total
bit 4: Input Curr Unbalance Shutdown - R
bit 5: Input Curr Unbalance Shutdown - S
bit 6: Input Curr Unbalance Shutdown - T  
bit 7: Input Curr Unbalance Shutdown - Total

points.name: Load on Bypass
points.floatStatus:
0 - Normal,
1 - Battery,
2 - Bypass (3phase Reserve Power Path),
3 - Reducing,
4 - Boosting,
5 - Manual Bypass,
6 - Other,
7 - No output,
8 - On ECO,
9 - Load Transfer Breaker,
10 - On Clean Mode,
11 - On Hybrid
points.vendorComment: Load on Bypass if value is 2 or 5
